purpose: Select an open-weight native text/image/audio backbone for MiSO v4 using measured decision quality and latency. This is a development study, not a claim of Jev or OpenAI parity.

input_policy.output: One distribution over caller-supplied candidate labels

text_rules.description: Original executable business-rule fixtures; synthetic and not a substitute for broad language benchmarks

speech_intent.description: Eight SLURP sentence intents with raw human recordings and disjoint utterance identities

sound_events.description: Real ESC-10 environmental sounds preserving original source folds

screen_region.description: Public ScreenSpot-Pro screenshots: select one of nine fixed screen regions containing the target center. Coarse localization, not official point grounding or browser execution

joint_control.description: Controlled keyword-plus-color panels requiring image and audio together; synthetic images, natural speech, and speaker-group splits

methods.label_logits: One forward pass; normalize logits for single-token candidate letters. Retain allowed-vocabulary mass and use a separate calibration temperature. No generated probability strings.
methods.trained_readout: Frozen backbone, train-only residual linear decision readout on its final hidden state; no base-weight tuning. This is a readout adaptation screen, not a completed general MiSO architecture.
methods.generated_output_control: Measure minimal-label and generated JSON controls on fixed development cases. Do not equate one label with the full probability contract.

selection.proper_score_gate: On every development track, calibrated NLL and Brier score must improve on uniform guessing; failures remain in the accuracy denominator and disqualify incomplete candidates.
selection.objective: Lowest equal-track mean of request p95 latency among development candidates passing every quality floor and within 3 percentage points of the best eligible macro accuracy
selection.uncertainty: Paired group-bootstrap 95 percent intervals; report ties and uncertainty. No statistical noninferiority claim merely from a point-estimate margin.
selection.confirmation: Freeze nomination and readout before opening confirmation results. Confirm the selected candidate and quality reference once; any revision needs a new version. If no candidate passes, report no qualified winner and nominate a research lead separately.
selection.scope: Winner within the measured candidate/runtime set; not fastest among every open model. Different supported attention runtimes must be disclosed.

timing.cost: Record allocated container wall time and resource rates; do not present forward-time multiplication as actual serving cost.

limitations: Public benchmark pretraining contamination is unknown
SLURP subset is English and limited to eight intents
Screen task is nine-region localization, not precise clicking
Readout training does not establish benefits of full adapter training or state reuse
Jev and OpenAI are proprietary API references and cannot be included in a literal same-hardware comparison
Quality thresholds are preregistered engineering selection criteria, not user-validated production acceptance
